name: starfield speed per engine: how far a star travels in one second
eval: (async()=>{const out=[];for(let e=0;e<8;e++){setParam('engine', e/7); setParam('thrust',0.35); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));const z0=stars.map(s=>s.z);const t0=performance.now();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));let d=0,n=0;for(let i=0;i<stars.length;i++){const dz=z0[i]-stars[i].z;if(dz>0&&dz<0.9){d+=dz;n++;}}out.push(ENGINES[e].name.slice(0,11).padEnd(11)+' '+(d/Math.max(1,n)).toFixed(4));}return out.join('\n     ');})()

eval: (async()=>{const meas=()=>{const d=ctx.getImageData(0,0,crt.width,crt.height).data;let s=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4)s+=d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2];return s/(d.length/4);};window.__BO.forceLevel=null;visEnv=0;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const quiet=meas();for(let k=0;k<40;k++){visEnv=1;await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));}const loud=meas();return 'quiet '+quiet.toFixed(1)+'  driven '+loud.toFixed(1)+'  (+'+(loud-quiet).toFixed(1)+')';})()
